annotations.title: Invoice payment terms and due dates

description: Invoice payment terms and due dates — Turns invoice terms like net 30, 2/10 net 30, net 45 EOM or due on receipt into the exact due date and early-payment discount deadline, moved off weekends and US federal holidays, with days until due or days overdue, the discount amount for a given invoice total, and the annualized cost of skipping the discount (about 37% a year for 2/10 net 30). Offline, instant. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).

terms.description: e.g. 2/10 net 30, net 45, net 30 eom, due on receipt (default net 30)
